summary: One component set 'Radio' with 8 variants (Theme Light/Dark x State Default/Disabled x Selected No/Yes, plus Show Label). Light theme is clean and uses registered styles; dark theme borrows orphaned components and doesn't dim disabled labels. Docs are spread across three overlapping blocks, with empty Example and Do/Don't panels, and there is no focus, error or group variant.

items.name: Light · Default · Unselected
items.use: 14x14 ring, 1px, #A3A3A3 (grey-medium, style Grey/Medium-#A3A3A3), empty centre. 10px gap to label. Label 'Unselected' Open Sans Regular 12, line height Auto (~16), #313131 (text-dark, style Text/Dark-#313131), text style Label/Regular/Normal. Hug width 87, height 16.
warn: Ring #A3A3A3 on white is 2.52:1, below the 3:1 non-text contrast guide (note only, a11y pass deferred).
Label line height is Auto (~16px); nearest class type-12-regular is 12/17.
Hidden child paths carry #D6D6D6 (not a token); not rendered because the boolean op fill wins.
items.rec: Keep. Map label to type-12-regular and decide 16 vs 17 line height.

items.name: Light · Default · Selected
items.use: 14x14 ring 1px plus 7x7 centre dot (3.5px inset), all #0076DD (pando-blue, style Primary/Pando-Blue-#0076DD). Label 'Selected' #313131, Label/Regular/Normal 12.
items.rec: Keep.

items.name: Light · Disabled · Unselected
items.use: Ring 1px #A3A3A3 (grey-medium) with a 12x12 inner fill #E7E7E7 (grey-light, style Grey/Light-#E7E7E7). Label 'Disabled' #6C6C6C (text-light, style Text/Light-#6C6C6C).
flags: Messy layer structure: the ring is drawn twice (a boolean op plus a duplicate copy inside group 'Object'), and the Radio frame has 1px padding the other variants don't.
warn: Label uses text-light #6C6C6C, not text-disabled #A3A2A2. Confirm which one is meant for disabled.
items.rec: Keep the look, clean up the layers to match the Default variants.

items.name: Light · Disabled · Selected
items.use: Ring 1px plus 7x7 dot, all #A3A3A3 (grey-medium). No inner fill. Label 'Selected Disabled' #6C6C6C (text-light).
warn: No #E7E7E7 inner fill here, unlike Disabled Unselected, so the two disabled variants don't share a background.
items.rec: Keep. Decide whether disabled-selected also gets the #E7E7E7 fill.

items.name: Dark theme · 4 variants
items.use: Same 14px ring, 10px gap. Unselected: ring #A3A3A3. Selected: ring and dot #9CD2FF (highlight-blue-light). Disabled unselected: ring #A3A3A3 with a #515151 (grey-dark) fill. Disabled selected: ring and dot #A3A3A3. All labels #D5DAF4 (dark-label-text, style Dark/Label-Text-#D5DAF4). Shown on a loose rectangle #393944.
flags: Disabled labels are #D5DAF4, the same as default, so disabled text is not dimmed in dark theme.

Selected, Disabled and Disabled-Selected use instances of 'Radio/Dark/Initial/No/Yes', 'Radio/Dark/Disabled/No/No', 'Radio/Dark/Disabled/No/Yes' (3344:3697, 3344:3702, 3344:3707). Those main components are no longer on the canvas (parent is null) — orphaned sources.
Dark Unselected has no 'Radio' wrapper frame, unlike every other variant.
Dark background rectangle 194:58 is #393944 with no style; token dark-bg is #393945.
warn: Disabled unselected #515151 fill on #393944 is 1.44:1 and reads like a dark filled dot. Selected #9CD2FF on #393944 is 7.1:1 (fine).
items.rec: Keep dark theme but rebuild the three variants from local layers, dim disabled labels, and use dark-bg #393945.

items.name: Component properties
items.use: Set 'Radio' has Theme (Light / Dark, default Light), State (Default / Disabled, default Default), Selected (No / Yes, default No), and a boolean Show Label (default true). 8 variants. Horizontal auto layout, gap 10, no padding, centred, hug width, 16 high.
flags: No Focus, Hover or Error state in the set.
warn: Variant widths come from label text (72–123px), so 'Selected Disabled' is just sample copy.
items.rec: Add Focus and Error to State before handoff.

items.name: Spectral sheet (Spacing / Anatomy / Properties)
items.use: Auto-generated spec sheet. Spacing: gap 10px, radio 14, label 63 wide, total 87. Anatomy: 1 Label, 2 Radio. Properties table lists each variant.
flags: Anatomy says Fill style 'Text/Dark-#404040' but the label actually uses Text/Dark-#313131.
Properties table shows a 'Focus' state with a blue ring, but no Focus variant exists in the component set.
Dark theme preview is on a light background, so the label is barely visible.
items.rec: Outdated. Regenerate after the component is fixed.

items.name: Overview
items.use: 'Radio buttons are used for mutually exclusive choices, not for multiple choices. Only one radio button can be selected at a time...' Same text also in the .documentation instance (3344:3749).
items.rec: Keep.

items.name: When to use
items.use: Two cases: Form (tiles, data tables, modals, side panels, full-page forms) and Settings (switching settings in a menu, page or component; can act as a filter).
flags: The same Form/Settings text is reused as 'Placement & Convention' in the .documentation instance, and the Placement block says nearly the same thing again — three overlapping copies.
items.rec: Keep, but say it once.

items.name: When not to use
items.use: If users can pick several options, use checkboxes instead.
warn: Loose text 3370:3644 has more 'use instead' advice (Switch, Select, Button Select). It sits outside every frame.
items.rec: Keep, and merge in the loose alternatives text.

items.name: Behaviour
items.use: Two states, unselected and selected. Default is no option preselected. Choosing a new item deselects the old one. To let users clear a choice, add an 'other' or 'none' option.
warn: This matches Carbon's guidance almost word for word. Fluent says to preselect an option when it makes sense. Decide which rule V1 follows.
items.rec: Keep. Confirm the default-selection rule.

items.name: Placement & Convention
items.use: Often used in forms on a full page, modal or side panel, and for settings or picking one item in a data table. The .documentation instance adds: 'Always provide a label for a radio button' and 'Present the options in a logical order for the best context.'
flags: Repeats the When to use content.
items.rec: Keep the two bullet rules. Drop the repeated text.

items.name: Example block (empty)
items.use: 1024x286 grey panel with pins 1 and 2, but no example content.
flags: Empty: the numbered pins point at nothing.
items.rec: Add a real example or remove the block.

items.name: Do / Don't (empty)
items.use: Do (5416:21987) and Don't (5416:21972) panels have only their status tags. No images or text.
items.rec: Add content (e.g. label every option, don't use for multi-select) or remove.

items.name: .documentation 'Variation Examples' (empty)
items.use: Older .documentation instance at the top of the page. Left side has Overview / Uses / Placement. Right panel 'Variation Examples' is empty.
flags: Duplicates the newer 'Radio Buttons' section docs, and the Variation Examples panel is empty.
items.rec: Outdated. Keep one doc source (the section) and retire this instance.

items.name: Loose dark background rectangle
items.use: 297x547 rectangle, #393944, no style, sitting behind the dark column of the component set.
flags: Not part of the component; hardcoded #393944 (token dark-bg is #393945).
items.rec: Skip. Give the set a styled dark panel instead.

items.name: Loose 'use instead' text
items.use: 'If there are two options showing an on/off setting, consider using Switch. For lists with more than ten options, consider using a Select. When there are only two or three options with short labels, consider using a Button Select.' 16px text outside all frames.
flags: Stray text node with useful guidance that isn't in any doc block.
items.rec: Keep the copy; move it into When not to use.

items.name: No focus state
items.use: V1 has no focus variant. Carbon lists focus as a standard state. The Spectral sheet shows a Focus ring that does not exist in the component.
items.rec: Add a Focus state with a visible ring.

items.name: No error / group label / helper text
items.use: Only single radios exist. Carbon offers a group label, helper text, and error, warning and read-only states at group level. Ant has Radio.Group with group-wide disable and vertical layout.
items.rec: Add a Radio Group with label, helper and error.

items.name: Keyboard behaviour not documented
items.use: Docs don't cover keyboard use. Standard: Tab moves into the group onto the checked (or first) option; arrow keys move and select; Space selects. The group needs a label (radiogroup role).
items.rec: Add a keyboard note to Behaviour.

items.name: Small target and light ring (note)
items.use: Control is 14px and the row is 16px high, below the 24x24 minimum unless spacing exempts it or the label is clickable. Ring #A3A3A3 on white is 2.52:1, below 3:1. Selected #0076DD on white is 4.53:1 (passes).
warn: Accessibility pass is deferred; note only.
items.rec: Later. Make the label part of the hit area and darken the ring.

items.name: No group layout or size options
items.use: No guidance on vertical vs horizontal stacking or spacing between options. Fluent prefers vertical stacking for scanning. Ant offers sizes and vertical layout.
items.rec: Later. Define stack direction and row gap.

newTextStyles: Label/Regular/Normal (Open Sans Regular 12, line height Auto) — not a type class; nearest is type-12-regular 12/17
